system.description: General worship of the whole Blessed Pantheon by spiritual people seeking pattern and purpose, holding that all events serve a divine plan for the common good.
system.summary: General worship of the whole Blessed Pantheon by spiritual people seeking pattern and purpose, holding that all events serve a divine plan for the common good.
commandments: Cut away every sinful or flawed act so only purity is left.
The Wheel is imperfect; describe what it ought to become.
Put the tangible and measurable ahead of the immaterial.
Give up present comfort for the sake of the future.
Bonds between people build Order; labor for the group over the self.

cults.name: Conspiracy Theorists
cults.summary: Obsessive pattern-seekers who link every event into a grand scheme, yet somehow keep turning up data they should not have.

cults.name: Voidheart
cults.summary: Ascetics who abandon personal desire through fasting and meditation and serve as trusted, incorruptible mediators.
